description: Wrap the master key under a separate recovery passphrase so the vault can be unlocked even if the primary passphrase is lost. Operator-only.
embedding_description: Vault: recovery / backup passphrase / second unlock path. Wrap the existing master key under a second KEK derived from a recovery passphrase. After this verb runs, the vault can be unlocked with either the primary passphrase or the recovery passphrase. The two passphrases are independent; rotating one does not affect the other. Operator-only — requires operator or operator-equivalent principal.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Recovery-key creation result. Contains message (status) and recovery_key_path (location of the persisted recovery-wrapped key).
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: Remind the operator to record the recovery passphrase in a separate trust boundary from the primary passphrase.
result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: No follow-up action required; the recovery path is now live and usable on the next unlock attempt.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Creates a second wrapping of the master key so the vault remains recoverable when the primary passphrase is lost.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: VaultNotInitialized: vault_init has not been run. VaultLocked: vault must be unlocked first so the master key is available for re-wrapping. RecoveryKeyAlreadyExists: a recovery key already exists. VaultAccessDeniedError: caller is not operator.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: For VaultNotInitialized: run vault_init first. For VaultLocked: unlock first. For RecoveryKeyAlreadyExists: re-creation is destructive — confirm intent and rotate explicitly. For VaultAccessDeniedError: re-invoke from operator-MCP context.
